mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT W.WISH_ID), PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME AS TITLE_IMAGE, MIN(PO.OPTION_PRICE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PO.OPTION_ID ASC) AS PRICE, NVL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(R.SCORE), 1) FROM REVIEW R JOIN OPTIONDETAIL SUB_OD ON R.OD_ID = SUB_OD.POP_ID WHERE SUB_OD.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID ), 0.0) AS SCORE FROM PRODUCT P JOIN CATEGORYDETAIL CD ON P.PRODUCT_ID = CD.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORY C ON CD.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID JOIN OPTIONDETAIL OD ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OD.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCTOPTION PO ON OD.OPTION_ID = PO.OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCTIMAGE PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 LEFT JOIN WISH W ON P.PRODUCT_ID = W.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, PI.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT W.WISH_ID) DESC
select product_image_save_name from productimage where productimage.product_title_image = 0
